name: Set Compose .env Value
description: Sets KEY=VALUE in the compose project's .env inside the LXC (/opt/docker-compose/<project>/.env, written from the application's env_file) and optionally runs after_command inside the LXC. Used by refresh-stack task for applications that read their secrets from that .env (e.g. apps that start their own compose stack from it), where compose-env has no environment entry to patch.
